patthana19.15:1.1: na ajjhattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bahiddhā dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana19.15:2.1: na bahiddhā dhammaṃ paṭicca ajjhatto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana19.15:4.1: na ajjhattārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ajjhattārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: dve.
patthana19.15:5.1: na bahiddhārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bahiddhārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: dve.
